_doc: Acquisition spend per campaign, used to derive CAC, payback and revenue/CAC. Amounts are USD; the build script converts with fxIlsPerUsd from channels.json. Set `isEstimate: true` when the number is reconstructed rather than taken from an invoice or ad account — the dashboard labels estimated CAC differently and never presents it as fact. Campaigns with no entry here show CAC as unknown rather than zero.
